name: OpenIntelligence Pipeline
description: 29-step end-to-end RAG pipeline: 6 ingestion + 23 query steps
source: Derived from .github/copilot-instructions.md, HOW_IT_WORKS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, ThinkingEvent.swift, RAGService.swift

compressionCap.note: Max chunks sent to LLM compression

compressionTimeout.note: Bails early if time runs out

E.name: Semantic Grounding
E.description: vDSP cosine: response embedding aligned with chunks

steps.name: Parse
steps.description: Extract text from documents using PDFKit, Vision OCR (360 DPI), or Office ZIP parsing

substeps.name: PHASE -1: Text Layer Validation
substeps.description: Jaccard similarity check: PDFKit text vs Vision OCR output. Font-encoded PDFs (Kia, Hyundai) have shifted characters. Threshold < 0.15 = garbled → full OCR forced. Prevents 93% content loss.

substeps.name: Page Complexity Analysis
substeps.description: PageComplexityAnalyzer scores text quality, table presence, numeric density, visual complexity. Tables/numbers → forced Vision OCR.

substeps.name: Dynamic Vocabulary Extraction
substeps.description: PDFKit text mined for acronyms, alphanumeric codes (0W-20, R-134a), CamelCase terms → Vision customWords.

substeps.name: Adaptive Preprocessing
substeps.description: 1 of 5 GPU-accelerated CIFilter strategies selected per page quality. Minimal (clean digital) → Maximum (faded microfiche). Concurrent DispatchQueue.

substeps.name: Multi-Candidate Confidence OCR
substeps.description: Vision returns topCandidates(5) per line. Numeric data requires 90% confidence (vs 85% text). Low-confidence alternatives flagged for verification.

substeps.name: Memory-Safe Image Analysis
substeps.description: Post-OCR image/diagram extraction. 5-page batches, 144 DPI (2× scale), autoreleasepool cleanup. Parsed results freed first (~100-200MB reclaimed).

steps.name: SemanticChunker
steps.description: Break documents into ≤310 word chunks with section detection. Tables preserved as atomic units. ~200 chunks per 50-page document.

steps.name: Entity Extraction
steps.description: NLTagger NER + PascalCase detection extracts named entities per chunk. Feeds EntityIndexService for per-container entity lookup.

steps.name: Token Validation
steps.description: BertTokenizer verifies each chunk ≤510 embedding tokens. Oversized chunks are re-split. Technical text ≠ 1.5 tokens/word.

steps.name: Embedding
steps.description: CoreML MiniLM-L6-v2 converts each chunk → 384-dim vector. GPU compute (.cpuAndGPU) during ingestion frees ANE for OCR.

steps.name: Store
steps.description: HNSW index + FullTextStorage (SQLite FTS5) + EntityIndex. Metal GPU 3-tier shader selection for vector storage.

steps.name: Corpus Analysis
steps.description: Vocabulary cache analysis — understand what the container knows before searching.

steps.name: Query Understanding
steps.description: Pronoun resolution, NER extraction, query normalization.

steps.name: Query Expansion
steps.description: Corpus + container vocabulary expansion. Synonyms, related terms, domain-specific alternatives.

steps.name: Intent Classification
steps.description: Classify query as lookup, procedure, compare, or summarize. Drives downstream routing.

steps.name: Query Embedding
steps.description: MiniLM-L6-v2 encodes user query → 384-dim vector for semantic search.

steps.name: RAPTOR-lite Routing
steps.description: Overview/high-level queries → L1 summary chunks. Specific queries → detail chunks. Prevents "tell me about everything" from flooding with fragments.

steps.name: Hybrid Search
steps.description: Vector Search (vDSP cosine) + BM25 (SQLite FTS5) run concurrently via async let. Results fused with RRF. OR: Iterative Retrieval for multi-hop intents.

substeps.name: Vector Search (Semantic)
substeps.description: vDSP-accelerated cosine similarity. Metal GPU 3-tier shader: Threadgroup (≥1000) → SIMD4 (100+) → Scalar fallback.

substeps.name: BM25 (Keyword)
substeps.description: SQLite FTS5 with AND-first queries, OR fallback. Weighted: section_title 10×, section_path 5×, content 1×.

substeps.name: Reciprocal Rank Fusion
substeps.description: Fuse vector + BM25 ranked lists into single ordering. ~50 candidates output.

steps.name: Cross-Encoder Rerank
steps.description: TinyBERT cross-encoder scores all query-chunk pairs. Concurrent TaskGroup (2-4 predictions by device tier). MLMultiArray bulk dataPointer writes.

steps.name: Low-Confidence Filtering
steps.description: Remove chunks below relevance threshold. Prevents noise from polluting context window.

steps.name: Multi-Document Representation
steps.description: Ensure source diversity — don't let one document dominate context. Balance chunks across sources.

steps.name: MMR Diversification
steps.description: Maximal Marginal Relevance (λ=0.6). Reduce redundancy while preserving relevance. Prevents 5 near-identical chunks.

steps.name: Parent Document Retrieval
steps.description: Expand to ±5 sibling chunks around top results. Recovers context split across chunk boundaries.

steps.name: Contextual Compression
steps.description: LLM filters irrelevant content from chunks. Max 5 chunks, fresh session per chunk. 12s budget, 1s cooldown between.

steps.name: Graph Context Packing
steps.description: Token-budget-aware packing via entity graph. Maximizes information density within 5500 char limit.

steps.name: Context Assembly
steps.description: Lost-in-Middle reorder: most important chunks at beginning and end. LLMs pay less attention to middle positions.

steps.name: Extractive Summarization
steps.description: For summarize intent: extract key sentences directly from chunks. Avoids LLM hallucination for pure summary requests.

steps.name: Extractive QA
steps.description: For lookup intent: try to extract answer directly before entering LLM generation. Can short-circuit Deep Think (saves 4-8 sessions).

steps.name: Topical Relevance Check
steps.description: Lexical overlap < 20% → Evidence-First mode. Cautious prompt: "Do NOT fill gaps with assumptions". Forces confidence disclosure.

steps.name: LLM Generation
steps.description: Apple Foundation Model (~3B params, 3.7-bit quantized). On-device or Private Cloud Compute. ~30 tokens/sec. Streaming output.

steps.name: Response Formatting
steps.description: Markdown preservation pipeline. normalizeInlineMarkdown() preprocessor handles Apple FM's single-line markdown concatenation.

steps.name: Quality Assessment
steps.description: Confidence scoring based on retrieval quality, generation coherence, and evidence alignment.

steps.name: Verification Gates A-G
steps.description: 7-gate anti-hallucination check. Critical (A,B,C,D,E) → abstain on fail. Advisory (F,G) → confidence penalty only.

substeps.name: Gate E: Semantic Grounding
substeps.description: vDSP cosine: response embedding aligned with chunks

steps.name: Package Results
steps.description: Assemble final response with metadata, source attribution, and confidence score.

steps.name: Calibrated Confidence
steps.description: Platt scaling converts raw confidence to calibrated probability estimate.

steps.name: Response Metadata
steps.description: Timing, sources, model used, tokens generated, tokens/sec, TTFT, gating decision, retrieval config.

steps.name: Markdown Rendering
steps.description: Block-level parser + inline normalizer. 6 regex patterns for Apple FM output quirks.

agenticOverlay.description: For Deep Think and Maximum modes, AgenticOrchestrator wraps the query pipeline with multi-session reasoning.

steps.name: Self-RAG Check
steps.description: Does this question even need documents? (If user asks '2+2', skip retrieval).

steps.name: Evaluate Retrieval Quality
steps.description: Check lexical relevance + semantic intent. Excellent → reasoning. Poor → graph expansion.

steps.name: HyDE (Hypothetical Document)
steps.description: Generate hypothetical answer, embed it, search with that embedding. Finds answers the original query might miss.

steps.name: Iterative Retrieval
steps.description: LLM analyzes gaps → generates new queries → retrieves again. 4-8 cycles for Deep Think, 8-50 for Maximum.

steps.name: Accumulation Pattern
steps.description: Each session's output saved to memory. Next session receives accumulated insights as input. Builds answers larger than any single context window.

steps.name: FactBank (Maximum)
steps.description: Maximum mode: parallel Deep Think chains on different document clusters. Results merged via cluster synthesis.

steps.name: Final Synthesis
steps.description: Combine all session outputs into coherent final answer. Self-RAG 2.0: sessions ADD details, don't second-guess valid answers.
